text: DSH File Explorer Preview Molstar 是面向 DSH Web 文件浏览器的 Mol* 三维结构预览插件。它把交互式结构查看器注册为文件预览面板，识别蛋白质结构、小分子和对接相关格式，并读取文本预览或核心服务提供的原始文件数据。用户可以切换自动、卡通、球棍和分子表面表示，选择按链或实体着色，复位视角、控制旋转，并查看原子、残基和链数量。它适合在浏览文件时快速检查分子结构；无需额外 API 密钥，但需要先启用文件浏览器核心及支持 WebGL 的浏览器。

DSH File Explorer Preview Molstar adds a Mol* viewer to DSH Web. It renders CIF, PDB, and small-molecule structures in 3D, with controls for representation, coloring, camera reset, and spin. It requires the file-explorer core and a WebGL-capable browser.
想在 DSH Web 里直接旋转查看 PDB 蛋白质结构。
有没有办法把 CIF 文件显示成可交互的三维分子模型？
我希望文件浏览器预览结构文件时不要只显示原始文本。
让 DSH 能预览 SDF、MOL2 这类小分子或对接文件。
查看分子时能不能切换卡通、球棍和表面表示？
想按蛋白质链着色，并快速重置三维视角。
I want to inspect a PDB structure as an interactive 3D model in DSH Web.
Can the file preview render CIF and small-molecule structures instead of raw text?
DSH File Explorer Preview Molstar 的功能「多格式结构预览」：在文件浏览器中打开 CIF、PDB、SDF、MOL2 等支持格式时解析并显示三维结构。
DSH File Explorer Preview Molstar 的功能「结构显示控制」：用户可切换卡通、球棍或表面表示，按链或实体着色，并复位相机或切换模型旋转。
DSH File Explorer Preview Molstar 的功能「解析状态信息」：预览面板展示格式标记；结构加载完成后显示原子、残基和链的数量。
DSH File Explorer Preview Molstar 使用前须知：三维查看需要支持 WebGL 的浏览器，且该预览为只读，不能编辑结构文件。（见 README.md:64-68）

@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · Features：- **3D structure viewer** built on [`molstar`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/molstar) (`PluginContext` + a minimal canvas — no full Mol\* UI).
- **Representation presets**: Auto / Cartoon / Ball & Stick / Molecular surface.
- **Coloring** by default / chain / entity, **reset camera**, **spin toggle**, and a **dark/light background** that follows DSH's `data-ds-dark-theme`.
- **Status bar** with the format badge and atom/residue/chain counts.
- **Localized** toolbar/status copy (中文 / English).
- **Large & binary files**: for files over the core's 2 MiB text cap (returned as the `text-large` kind since dsh-file-explorer v0.3.0), and for `.bcif`, the plugin fetches raw bytes through the core's `fileExplorer.readRawFile` (standard in dsh-file-explorer v0.1.0+).

@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · Supported formats：| Extension | Format |
|-----------|--------|
| `cif` `mmcif` `mcif` | mmCIF |
| `bcif` | BinaryCIF |
| `pdb` `ent` | PDB |
| `pdbqt` | PDBQT |
| `pqr` | PQR |
| `sdf` `sd` | SDF |
| `mol` | MOL |
| `mol2` | MOL2 |
| `xyz` | XYZ |
| `gro` | GRO |

@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · From the Git repository：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wolfsonliu/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar
dsh web
```

@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · From source：```sh
git clone https://github.com/wolfsonliu/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar
cd dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar
npm install
npm run build

@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · Dependencies：This plugin **requires** [`@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer`](https://github.com/wolfsonliu/dsh-file-explorer) v0.1.0 or later — it injects the `fileExplorer` cordis service (`registerViewer` / `registerPreview` / `writeFile` / `readRawFile`). Install and enable `dsh-file-explorer` before this plugin:

```sh
@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · install the core from git：dsh plugin --profile web add github:wolfsonliu/dsh-file-explorer

@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · or, from source：git clone https://github.com/wolfsonliu/dsh-file-explorer
cd dsh-file-explorer
npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add .
```

> For local development, this repo's `devDependencies` resolves `@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer`'s `./client` type definitions. Point it at your checkout or your registry's published package before `npm install`.

@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · or, from source：For files ≤ 2 MiB the plugin parses the `text` preview content directly. For larger text files (`text-large` since v0.3.0) and `.bcif`, the plugin uses `readRawFile` to fetch raw bytes — a standard part of the `FileExplorerService` contract since dsh-file-explorer v0.1.0. Since dsh-file-explorer v0.7.0 the plugin passes an `AbortSignal` so the in-flight read is aborted when you switch files or close the preview.

@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · or, from source：On dsh-file-explorer v0.9.0+ the plugin registers one **named** viewer via `registerViewer` — `id: 'molstar'`, label **Mol\* Structure** — across every supported extension, so the **Open with…** menu and the preview-panel viewer switcher show a proper name instead of the generic "Extension viewer". On older cores (pre-v0.9.0) it falls back to one `registerPreview` per extension.

@dsh-external/dsh-file-explorer-preview-molstar README · Development：```sh
npm run check   # tsc type check
npm test        # vitest unit tests
npm run build   # tsc + tsdown (single-file lib/client.js bundling molstar)
```

The real WebGL mount cannot run under jsdom; verify it with `dsh web` and a structure file in `examples/`.

> After `npm run build`, hard-refresh the browser (`Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+R`): `dsh web` may keep serving a cached plugin bundle, so a soft reload can leave your latest build unused.
